page: Amazon Web Services i7ie.6xlarge is a storage-optimized server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8559C x86_64 processor operating at 3.2 GHz, delivering 24 vCPUs across 12 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The processor includes a 320 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions for accelerated matrix operations. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory running at 6 GHz, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB per core.

For storage-heavy workloads, the i7ie.6xlarge bundles 15,000 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, offering massive capacity and high-throughput local I/O. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps. There are no GPUs included in this configuration, making it a CPU-centric platform.

Benchmark results indicate strong capabilities in memory and data processing. The server achieves a top-tier single-core Geekbench score of 2314.0 and a strong multi-core score of 16504.0. Memory performance is highlighted by a strong large-block write bandwidth of 107.16 GB/sec and a strong Passmark memory score of 2868.29. Single-threaded gzip compression performs strongly at 34.65 GB/sec, while static web serving throughput reaches 45.64 GB/sec. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of local NVMe SSD storage combined with DDR5 memory provides a balanced resource profile for data-intensive applications without the overhead of external storage attachments.

The AWS i7ie.6xlarge is optimized for high-capacity databases, large-scale transactional systems, and data-intensive applications. Its hardware profile is well-suited for relational and non-relational databases, data warehousing, caching layers, and high-throughput web serving.
